scope: Single complete offline source SDK ZIP per platform below 3 MiB; mandatory one-time offline preparation on the developer computer, never strong decompression in the app.
checks: Both final SDK ZIPs pass integrity and the strict 3145728-byte limit
Both final ZIPs compile their bundled decoder and restore all 60 assets offline with exact SHA-256 verification
Preparation tests reject traversal/output collisions/invalid layouts, reuse intact assets, repair same-size corruption and missing files, and preserve existing assets on failure
34 Chromium/WebKit real-runtime and bridge checks using the restored final SDK assets; no external requests
44 HEIF color/pixel checks using the pruned decoder and compact image WASM; one private Apple-image fixture unavailable
328 conversion fixture checks using the compact complete core and image WASM
Production Rust 1.93.0 mobile WASM build reproduces both previously validated binary hashes
Android Java compiles against API 35/WebKit 1.12.1/Brotli 0.1.2; native stream and byte-range checks pass, including mixed single/bulk reads and fallback without the Brotli dependency
Android Brotli decoder restores all 56 compressed final assets exactly
Swift direct server compilation and 16 real HTTP checks cover Brotli/gzip/raw, MIME, HEAD, Range and path containment; view source parses
Required license headers, upstream references and complete compressed third-party notices are retained
notRun: Full Gradle AAR / IPA builds and physical-device tests
Standard swift test: local SwiftPM PackageDescription manifest linker failure; direct Swift/HTTP harness used

performance.scope: macOS JDK host microbenchmark, not physical Android device latency
performance.note: The buffered path fixes mixed-read byte loss; measured overhead approximately 0.8%. Phone performance is not established.
